name: clearlane-mcp
stderr:
Usage: clearlane [options] [command]

ClearLane MCP: audit-ready bus reliability investigations.

Options:
  -V, --version                     output the version number
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                    Create ClearLane config and MCP client
                                    configuration.
  configure [options]               Securely configure local ClearLane
                                    credentials without pasting secrets into
                                    chat.
  auth                              Manage ClearLane credential status.
  mcp                               Start the ClearLane MCP stdio server.
  ask [options] <question...>       Answer a natural-language transit
                                    reliability question with auditable
                                    artifacts.
  audit [options]                   Run an audit-ready bus reliability
                                    investigation.
  analyze-evidence [options] <dir>  Analyze optional image/video evidence.
  report [options]                  Regenerate reports from existing
                                    route-health JSON.
  verify-ledger <ledger>            Verify a ClearLane audit ledger hash chain.
  doctor                            Print local setup diagnostics without
                                    exposing secret values.
  inspect-source [options]          Inspect a Socrata dataset sample.
  help [command]                    display help for command
